settings.heading: Full-zip heavyweight build
settings.text: A sturdy front zip and heavyweight fabric that holds its shape wear after wear.

settings.heading: Embroidered team crest
settings.text: Officially inspired crest patch, stitched (not printed) for a durable finish.

settings.heading: Bold sleeve branding
settings.text: Vintage-style lettering down the sleeve, a detail fast-fashion copies skip.

settings.heading: Ribbed cuffs & hem
settings.text: Reinforced ribbing keeps the fit snug and the jacket looking sharp longer.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Delivery takes 3-5 business days within Portugal and 5-10 business days for the rest of Europe. You'll get a shipping confirmation email as soon as your order is on its way. Full details on our Shipping Policy page.

settings.heading: How do I track my order?
settings.row_content: As soon as your order ships, we'll email you a tracking number and a link so you can follow your package every step of the way. You can also track your order anytime from our Track Your Order page.

settings.heading: Can I return or exchange?
settings.row_content: Yes! We accept returns and exchanges within 14 days of delivery, as long as the item is unused, unworn and in its original packaging. See our full Refund Policy or email us at support@overtake.pt and we'll walk you through the process.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right size?
settings.row_content: Check the size chart on each product page, or our full Size Guide, for detailed measurements. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a more relaxed, oversized fit. Still unsure? Reach out and our team will help you pick the right size.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through our secure checkout. If you run into any issues completing your payment, reach out and we'll help you sort it out.
